Approve an Expense Report

User manual · English · 9 steps
Learn how a manager finds the expense reports waiting for approval, checks what the employee claimed, and approves the report so it can be paid back.

1. Open Expenses

Open the Expenses app.

2. Expense Reports

Open Expense Reports.

3. Open the search options

Click here to open the search options.

4. Group by Status

Choose Status to group the reports by their status.

5. Close the search options

Click here again to close the menu.

6. Open the Submitted group

Click the Submitted group to see the reports waiting for approval.

7. Open the report

Click the report to open it.

8. Check the total

Check the total amount of the report. Click it to continue.

9. Approve

Click Approve to accept the report.
